paragraphs: Avin bar Chisda said in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, end of Chavit. He brought a bill of divorce before Rabbi Yochanan, Gittin 5b. Midrash Chazit, on “Your navel is a rounded bowl” and “I will ascend the palm tree”: Rabbi Avin bar Chisri.
